items.title: 66100_Bud Freeman oral history interview
items.q: Jess had the job and he heard I was in town and he said, 'Come on up and we will give you your room and board and we will pick-up what we can.'

ctx.x: Well, Jess, there's a marvelous thing to be said for Jess. You know, in all the years, Jess and I had a job -- now, we had both been with the best bands. I was with all the top bands, Dorsey Brothers, and what not, and I would go back to Chicago every once in awhile, because I would see my dad and stay at home for awhile, and Jess had a job at a summer resort called -- it was near Dowagiac, Michigan, and I can't remember the name of the lake now -- it was on a lake and we were to play for dancing.
Jess had the job and he heard I was in town and he said, 'Come on up and we will give you your room and board and we will pick-up what we can.' I think we made about $2.50 a week apiece.

We had an absolute ball. We would play golf and baseball in the daytime and would be out in the sun all the time, having a very healthy life. We didn't really need any money, and we were playing together which was what we wanted to do.
